items.description: GET /api/stock-records returns a bare JSON array containing exactly the three seeded records (WID-001/A-01/12, BOLT-07/A-01/40, WID-001/B-02/3), each with id, sku, location, quantity and tracking_code, using per-run-unique SKUs/locations
GET /api/stock-records returns records ordered by location then sku, so records at the same location are adjacent

Downgrading to the SC2 add-index migration's own down_revision (the SC1 create-table revision id, not a relative step) then upgrading head recreates index ix_stock_records_location_sku on (location, sku) on the paired branch
Stock records seeded with per-run-unique keys survive the SC2 add-index migration downgrade to its own down_revision and upgrade head with their original sku, location and quantity values
GET /api/stock-records responds with Content-Type application/json and a bare JSON array body
The test session's engine URL is read from the DATABASE_URL environment variable and resolves to the paired Lakebase branch, not sqlite or in-memory
The alembic head, including the SC2 index revision, is applied on the paired branch before the list tests run
StockTable rendered against a mocked GET /api/stock-records response shows one stock-row per seeded record inside the stock-table seam

StockTable rendered against mocked records at two locations shows each row's stock-cell-sku, stock-cell-location and stock-cell-quantity text with records at the same location adjacent in the order the API returned them

Playwright e2e navigates to `/` through the real App against the live API with three seeded records (run-unique SKUs, two sharing a location) and asserts exactly three stock-row elements appear inside the stock-table, each with stock-cell-sku, stock-cell-location and stock-cell-quantity, ordered by location with same-location rows adjacent under a location-group header (client/tests/e2e/stock-by-location.spec.ts)
StockTable rendered against a mocked empty API response shows the empty-state seam with its empty-state-cta link to /stock/new instead of the stock-table

Playwright e2e opens `/` against the live API with no stock records and asserts the empty-state with text 'No stock filed yet' is visible, its empty-state-cta links to /stock/new, and the stock-table is not rendered (client/tests/e2e/stock-empty-state.spec.ts)
A row for a record filed with no tracking code, from a mocked API response, renders the not-tracked pill with the text 'not tracked' in stock-cell-tracking-code, never blank or 'null'
A row for a record filed with a tracking code, from a mocked API response, renders that code text in stock-cell-tracking-code without the not-tracked pill

Playwright e2e opens `/` against the live API with one untracked record and one tracked record (run-unique SKUs) and asserts the untracked row's stock-cell-tracking-code contains the not-tracked pill reading 'not tracked' while the tracked row's cell shows its code value (client/tests/e2e/stock-not-tracked.spec.ts)

Playwright e2e on the live app files a record with a run-unique SKU at C-03 quantity 8 via the stock-record-form at /stock/new, returns to `/` through the navbar Stock link, and asserts the new stock-row appears in the stock-table with no document navigation or full-page reload (client/tests/e2e/stock-new-record-appears.spec.ts)
